Name: JP's Upgradeable Barns and Coops - More Animals - Big Interiors
Author: juanpa98ar
Description:
[font=Georgia][size=6][center][b][i][color=#00ff00][u]Upgradeable Barns and Coops[/u][/color][/i][/b][/center][/size]

[b][i][color=#ff00ff][size=5]Be a single person with lots of animals and hire employees? Nah.
Be a single person with lots of animals and get even more animals? That's the way to go, buddy.[/size][/color][/i][/b]


[size=4]This mod does two things: it increases the size of the first three levels of these two buildings, and it clears their interiors of unnecessary obstacles and gives them a general clean-up. 
On the other hand, it adds two new building levels, with new and larger exteriors and interiors. They include additional feeders. [/size]


[color=#00ffff][size=4][b]Barn:[/b][/size][/color]
[list]
[*][size=3]Lvl 1: Increased the interior size from 18x15 to 20x17. General cleaning.[/size]
[*][size=3]Lvl 2: Increased the interior size from 22x15 to 24x17. General cleaning.[/size]
[*][size=3]Lvl 3: Increased the interior size from 25x15 to 27x17. General cleaning.[/size]
[*][size=3]Lvl 4: Interior dimensions: 30x17. Four feeders added, space for 16 animals. [b]Time & Cost:[/b] 2 days | 50,000 Gold | 650 Wood, 400 Stone[/size]
[*][size=3]Lvl 5: Interior size of 32x20. Added 4 more feeders, space for 20 animals. [b]Time & Cost:[/b] 2 days | 110,000 Gold | 750 Wood, 500 Stone[/size]
[/list]
[b][color=#00ffff][size=4]Coop:[/size][/color][/b]
[list]
[*][size=3]Lvl 1: Increased the interior size from 12x10 to 14x12. General cleaning.[/size]
[/list][list]
[*][size=3]Lvl 2: Increased the interior size from 16x10 to 18x12. General cleaning.[/size]
[*][size=3]Lvl 3: Increased the interior size from 23x10 to 25x12. General cleaning.[/size]
[*][size=3]Lvl 4: Interior dimensions: 28x12. Four feeders added, space for 16 animals. [b]Time & Cost:[/b] 2 days | 40,000 Gold | 600 Wood, 250 Stone[/size]
[/list][list]
[*][size=3]Lvl 5: Interior size of 30x15. Added 4 more feeders, space for 20 animals. One additional incubator. [b]Time & Cost:[/b] 2 days | 90,000 Gold | 750 Wood, 350 Stone[/size]
[/list][size=3]

[/size][color=#00ff00][size=5][b][i]That's it, improvements to the buildings in every way and more animals to take care of, many more animals to take care of. 
[/i][/b][/size][/color]

[i][color=#ffff00][size=6][u]Translations[/u][/size][/color][/i]
[size=4]You are free to translate the mod; [color=#ff0000]you don't need to ask my permission[/color].
You can publish it yourself on Nexusmods or send it to me to integrate it, it's up to you.
If you like, you can also let me know that your translation has been published, so I know you're out there.
